description: Author, fork, extend, certify (4-invariant zero-float Stratum < 255), sign with non-custodial Ed25519 + RFC 9421, and publish Knowledge Cartridges with optional non-commercial creator fees in integer microDollars. Trigger when creating a new Knowledge Cartridge, extending a built-in discovery, minting a community Skill pack, or checking Commons lineage seals.

creatorFeeMicroDollars.description: Optional non-commercial creator fee in integer microDollars (0 = free). [Zero-Float Unit: microDollars (Int64)]

domainHex.description: Sovereign domain code (e.g. 0x0101..0x0114). [Zero-Float Unit: Hex domain code]

parentSeal.description: Optional parent AMB-128 seal when forking or extending an existing discovery. [Zero-Float Unit: AMB-128 hex seal]

title.description: Human title for the Knowledge Cartridge or Skill extension. [Zero-Float Unit: UTF-8 title]

name: affine_kc_creator_commons
